
 Usage: openajar [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

 openajar gives every agent its own computer in the cloud: a terminal, a real
 browser and your repo. New here? `openajar setup`. Every day: `openajar help`.

╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --version                     Print the openajar version and exit.           │
│ --install-completion          Install completion for the current shell.      │
│ --show-completion             Show completion for the current shell, to copy │
│                               it or customize the installation.              │
│ --help                        Show this message and exit.                    │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Start here ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ setup         Start here: VMs, GitHub, limits, and Claude Code and Codex.    │
│ up            Set up and start this box, then print a sign-in link.          │
│ connect       Let the agents on your computer use a node.                    │
│ status        Is it up, and which lanes it has (--check: what is wrong).     │
│ open          Watch a lane live and take control (--terminal: a dashboard).  │
│ mcp           openajar as a stdio MCP server, for any MCP client.            │
│ local         openajar on this computer: start, stop, status, logs.          │
│ web           The web app in your browser: install, update, remove.          │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Build and check ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ run           Run a command on the node against this working tree.           │
│ expose        Your laptop's dev server, opened in one browser lane.          │
│ environments  Your agents' cloud computers: list, show, close, setup, repo.  │
│ studio        Check the pages you build: layout, contrast, brand, changes.   │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Lanes and work ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ lane          Browser lanes (one account each), devices and proxies.         │
│ workspace     Workspaces: one per business or person, with memory, members.  │
│ vault         Logins, codes and keys the lanes use, and mailboxes.           │
│ access        What agents may do: grants, approvals, freezes, the log.       │
│ routines      Work that runs by itself: flows, schedules, workflows, brains. │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ This box ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ node          Set up, run, back up and upgrade this node.                    │
│ controller    One address for Claude Code to reach several nodes.            │
│ panel         The web panel: sign in, see lanes, approve from a browser.     │
│ dev           For builders: a fake node, the tool and error references.      │
│ help          The everyday commands, and the version.                        │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
